title: Recovering remaining water
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: The large intestine absorbs much of the remaining water and electrolytes from material entering it. Much water was already absorbed in the small intestine.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which part of the digestive tract absorbs much of the water remaining in material that has passed through the small intestine? The large intestine absorbs much of the remaining water and electrolytes from material entering it. Much water was already absorbed in the small intestine.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
